title: Toolbox » Forms Inbox » Contact Us Form | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Toolbox » Forms Inbox » Contact Us Form Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000009368 The contact form is intended for website users to contact the website administrator directly. Users can access this form through the following link: https://www.examplesite.com/about/contact Where Do Messages Sent Via This Form Go? Access contact form submissions by navigating to Emails >> Forms Inbox : Email Notifications Website Administrator To turn on the notifications for the Contact Form, you can add the emails that you want to get notified in the Email Notifications for this form. The following article explains how to enable email notifications for forms: Edit Form Settings » Email Notifications Once the emails have been added in the email notifications for the Contact Us form, the website administrator will receive the following email template the moment the contact details form is completed: contact-form-submission This is how the email will look like in the admin email inbox: Form Submitter The person that submits this form will also get an email: This is what it looks like in the email inbox: Default Form Layout The layout can be edited under Content >> Web Page Builder : How To Reply The best way to reply to inquiries that are submitted via the contact details form is to go to Emails >> Form Inbox in the admin: From here, reply directly via the admin. ** Please note that any further back and forth emails will not be recorded here and rather in the administrator email account. It is also possible to add notes: And to " Archive " or " Delete " the inquiry under Actions: This can be done in bulk as well if needed: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
